### User interactions

#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Activate the trigger to open the dropdown, then choose an item. |
| Using the component | Close the dropdown to leave without selecting an action. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> / <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> | Moves focus between menu items. |
| <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> / <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd> | Opens or closes a submenu and moves focus appropriately. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Moves focus to the first or last item. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activates an item or toggles its submenu. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Closes the menu. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
